item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: One Coffee Ad Three Shapes

turns.text: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit.

item.tests: Produces three genuinely adapted aspect-ratio variants of one cohesive ad rather than unrelated designs or cropped copies.

answer_sheet.Brand and exact wording: Daybreak Coffee; Fresh start. Better coffee.; Shop now
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and dark green with a steaming coffee cup; one consistent campaign.
answer_sheet.Source assets: No supplied assets; create the coffee imagery.

must_haves: Three separate finished images are supplied, one each in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.
All three feature a steaming coffee cup and a consistent cream-and-dark-green palette.
Each image contains the exact brand, headline and call to action specified.
The cup design, typography and visual styling clearly belong to the same campaign across all three images.
Each layout fits its canvas without stretched imagery, clipped copy or large blank padding used merely to change the aspect ratio.

turns.text: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Keep the same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do this?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent any credits.** I’d make these as three **static ads**, not videos—there’s no duration cost.

### Proposed cost
Using the free-plan **Flux 2 Klein at 640px**:

| Step | Estimated credits |
|---|---:|
| Create one master campaign design | 5 |
| Adapt it to vertical 9:16 | 5 |
| Adapt it to wide 16:9 | 5 |
| **Total for all three sizes** | **15** |

These are estimates from the tools’ listed starting prices, not a verified account-specific quote. Extra generations or revisions would add cost; I wouldn’t run those without approval.

### Keeping the campaign consistent
Start with the square design: a steaming coffee cup, cream background, dark-green accents, and your exact copy:
- **Daybreak Coffee**
- **Fresh start. Better coffee.**
- **Shop now**

Then use that master as the reference for the other layouts rather than generating three unrelated designs. AI-rendered lettering can still contain errors, so exact copy needs checking.

### Cheaper option
**About 5 credits:** generate just the coffee artwork once, then add the exact wording and rearrange it into three sizes in a free layout editor. That’s cheaper and more reliable for typography, though the final layouts would be completed outside these generation tools. Smaller than the proposed 640px setting offers no listed cheaper tier.

**Important for an ad:** Magic Hour’s workflow guidance says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or an agreed paid usage arrangement; a free account alone isn’t sufficient.

Would you prefer the **approximately 15-credit three-size workflow**, or the **approximately 5-credit artwork-only option**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the approximately 5-credit artwork-only option.

dialog.agent:
For the artwork-only option, I recommend leaving the image text-free so you can add all three lines accurately in your layout editor.

Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.user: No words on the artwork—just the steaming coffee cup in cream and dark green. I’ll add the wording in the layout editor.

turns.agent:
The generation was **refused because your account has insufficient credits**. No artwork was created, and no generation credits were spent.

The selected option is one **640px, text-free square image**, estimated at **5 credits**. I haven’t retried or started anything else.

You can add credits and ask me to try again, or use an existing coffee photo in your layout editor to avoid generation costs entirely.
